name: 方釩溱
objective:
本課程介紹金融科技（FinTech）之基本概念、核心技術及金融創新應用，期待同學瞭解人工智慧、區塊鏈、雲端運算、生物辨識等新興科技如何改變金融服務模式，並探討金融監理、資訊安全、個人資料保護、洗錢防制及永續金融等重要議題。透過案例分析與專題報告，培養同學跨領域思維及金融科技素養。

This course introduces the fundamental concepts, enabling technologies, and innovative applications of Financial Technology (FinTech). Students will explore how artificial intelligence, blockchain, cloud computing, biometric authentication, cybersecurity, and sustainable finance are transforming financial services. The course also discusses financial regulation, personal data protection, anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorism financing (CTF), and fraud prevention. Through case studies and presentations, students will develop interdisciplinary perspectives and FinTech literacy.
